productCount.description: Visible, in-stock products; child categories are counted into the parent

key.description: Object key inside the storage driver

url.description: Public URL (empty for private objects — fetch via the seller/appropriate route)

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page

total.description: Cursor-mode only (`includeTotal=true`, first page): total matching rows

charge.description: Delivery charge as a decimal string; null when not deliverable

freeDeliveryAbove.description: Free-delivery threshold as a decimal string; null when none

target.description: Reported content in context (body/rating, author, product {id,name,slug})

hidden.description: Whether the reported content was hidden

hide.description: true hides the reported content, false keeps it

district.description: Shop's own district name (seller-entered, not localized)

verified.description: True when the seller profile is APPROVED

priceChanged.description: Unit price changed since this line was added/updated

priceChangedFrom.description: The snapshot price when the line was added (null if unchanged/unknown)

deliverable.description: The shop can deliver to the chosen district. null when no districtId was passed, false when a district was chosen but the shop has no active zone covering it, true otherwise.

deliveryCharge.description: Delivery charge as a decimal string; null when no districtId passed or not deliverable

freeDeliveryAbove.description: Free-delivery threshold of the matched zone as a decimal string; null when none or no districtId

priceChanged.description: At least one line's price changed since it was added
Any line changed price since it was added

changedLineCount.description: Number of lines whose price changed

shopOrders.description: Shop orders with items, status history and payments

expectedGrandTotal.description: Grand total the customer saw on the cart. When it no longer matches, checkout returns 409 PRICE_CHANGED and applies nothing.

overallStatus.description: Derived from the shop orders' states

deliveryNote.description: Optional seller note recorded when marking DELIVERED

amount.description: Decimal as string (positive = owed to seller)

availableAt.description: When a positive entry unlocks (null = immediate/negative)

available.description: Payout-able amount (unlocked positive minus negative entries)

owedToPlatform.description: Amount the seller owes the platform (when available < 0)

balance.description: Ledger balance as a decimal string (positive = owed to seller)
Decimal as string (positive = owed to seller)

pending.description: Held positive entries (payout hold / open complaint)

owedToPlatform.description: Amount owed to the platform when available < 0

available.description: False when the product or its shop is unavailable

hidden.description: Whether the reported review was hidden

hide.description: true hides the review, false keeps it

ticket.description: One-time ticket to authenticate the WebSocket connection

unansweredQuestions.description: Visible product questions with no visible answer

falseDeliveryFlags.description: Times customers reported a delivered order as not delivered

openOrderCount.description: Open (non-terminal) shop orders across the seller's shops
